decision: Implement and check the proposed memory reductions before returning to M1 lifecycle integration; this is not a new model or fitting study.

scope.reference: Preserved B001/B002 fixed-chart Gaussian local evidence and analytic remainder
scope.implementation: Separate compact C APIs; original source and receipts unchanged
retained: All joint coordinates and cross terms
History/event QR grouping and compressed-row merge order
Original chart, source identity, actual intervals, chronology, carried state
All sparse remainder coefficients, last-bound audit fields and pair maps
Atomic failed updates and paired ancestry
reductions: One immutable caller-owned configuration instead of duplicated values
Generate joint row directly instead of dense model-row and separate Jacobian temporaries
Stage only the changed QR factor, model and metadata
Compute only current SOC/capacity reports with full-joint eigensystem; share scratch across serialized phases
scope.stricter_guard: Compact assessment returns -1 if the squared target-gradient norm overflows; the original can continue with a nonfinite norm. Rejected query never modifies evidence.

primary.anchor_scope: Previously estimated 1800s anchor; prefix compressed retrospectively, final300s causal. No autonomous cold start demonstrated.
primary.failure_rule: Preserve first primary receipt and every failure. Any necessary correction is separately recorded, without relaxing gates.

acceptance.core_parity: Exact numeric equality of all meaningful factor/state/metadata/remainder values and query statuses at every sample; signed-zero/bitwise differences reported separately
acceptance.atomic_failure: Each rejected call leaves its own public banks byte-for-byte unchanged
acceptance.diagnostic_discrete_fields: Exact statuses/reasons/rank for non-boundary fixtures and primary trajectory
acceptance.memory: Actual sizeof each backing object and phase aggregate, compiler stack report, explicit external costs; no complete firmware claim
acceptance.local_curvature: On the primary trace compare raw full-joint SOC/logQ variances from both eigensystems under the same target tolerance, while keeping optimizer_status=1 and returned target ranges unresolved.

targeted_tests: One/two/three modes and original packing stride
Zero and varied actual intervals, current signs and PWL OCV evidence-only path
Exact old QR grouping and single-row-event construction including zero/leading-zero cases
Full-joint rank/null-space and selected-target diagnostics; degenerate and near-cutoff matrices

memory_estimate_before_implementation_by.scope: Host ABI estimate, not measurement; excludes library/caller/IRQ/runtime stack, acquisition backlog, persistent reporting copy and recovery staging

limits: No reduced rank, quantization, event regrouping, codebook classifier or semi-Markov inference
Only SOC/Q diagnostic outputs; nuisance targets remain unassessed, not fixed
No historical relinearization, autonomous nonlinear learner, checkpoint portability or reset integration
No new all-prefix stability or outward-rounding/coverage guarantee
No Cortex-M23 qualification or runtime speedup promise
next: After one implementation/verification result, resume M1/A1-A3 from the delivery roadmap. Select later bounded learner using the same lifecycle harness.
